items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: Camille something, from the West, from Los Angeles... No, she worked with a band.

ctx.x: All of them come played the Apollo. And what's what chick, Camille something, from the West, from Los Angeles...

No, she worked with a band. And boy, it was a swingin' little band. Little cat looked like Baby Dodds. She had a swingin' little band, one of them rhythm-and-blues bands in California. The Honey Drippers. Then they had what... Then Earl Bostic got a band, a small band.

items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: And what's what chick, Camille something, from the West, from Los Angeles...

ctx.x: Were those bands around New York? I don't know about them guys.
